title: Deal Status
description: Status of a curation deal on an SSP platform.

enumDescriptions.pending_approval: Deal created but awaiting curator or SSP approval
enumDescriptions.pending_activation: Deal approved but not yet live on the SSP
enumDescriptions.active: Deal is live and accepting bids
enumDescriptions.completed: Deal has finished its flight dates
enumDescriptions.failed: Deal activation failed on the SSP
enumDescriptions.rejected: Deal was rejected by the curator or SSP
enumDescriptions.canceled: Deal was canceled by the buyer before completion
